# CG-REQ-004: New required request parameter

A new required query, header or cookie parameter.

**Why it matters:** Requests valid under the baseline lack the new required parameter.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Requests](./#req) |
| Detects | `parameter.added` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> New required {where}.
>
> Existing consumers do not send this parameter, so their requests will be rejected.
>
> **Fix:** Make the parameter optional with a default, or release as a new major version.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: required header added

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       parameters: [{name: q, in: query, schema: {type: string}}]
+       parameters: [{name: q, in: query, schema: {type: string}}, {name: X-Tenant, in: header, required: true, schema: {type: string}}]
        responses: {'200': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Breaking, high. New required GET /x: header parameter "x-tenant".

### Does not fire: optional parameter added

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       parameters: [{name: q, in: query, schema: {type: string}}]
+       parameters: [{name: q, in: query, schema: {type: string}}, {name: s, in: query, schema: {type: string}}]
        responses: {'200': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

### Does not fire: parameter moved location

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       parameters: [{name: api_key, in: query, schema: {type: string}}]
+       parameters: [{name: api_key, in: header, required: true, schema: {type: string}}]
        responses: {'200': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.
